vis.scope: MeasurementSet supplying field names and IDs.

tablein.scope: Existing calibration table. G, T, B, K and Fringe tables have paired coverage. Saved CASA table selections are materialized before editing.

caltable.scope: Separate result or an in-place update when empty. An actively locked product is preserved.

field.scope: Field selection expression or a list. Empty selects all fields.

smoothtype.scope: Mean or median over valid solutions. Complex smoothing operates on amplitude and tracked phase.

smoothtime.scope: Strictly positive full duration in seconds. Paired cases include integer inputs and samples on window boundaries.

ratesmooth.scope: Include fringe rate predictions when tracking phase. Ordinary gain solutions are unaffected.

behaviors.title: Calibration table operation
behaviors.scope: Time windows, selected fields, mean and median, complex phase tracking, real delays, flags, uncertainties, in-place updates and rate-aware fringe solutions. Includes saved table views, required scalar paths, blank selectors, boolean duration, staged spectral-window flags, and actively locked destination rejection.
behaviors.gap: The documented CASA behavior differences are recorded below.

decisions.inputs: Fringe Jones smoothing with smoothtype set to median.
decisions.casa: Wraps delay and other non-phase values as radians and bypasses their median.
decisions.ours: Preserves their units and applies the numerical median to each non-phase series.
decisions.rationale: The source condition applies phase handling to every parameter. An 8 ns delay became about 1.717 ns.
decisions.impact: The fringe phase comparisons pass and the non-phase outputs follow independently calculated medians.

paired.kind: Same-input Python task and casacore interchange
paired.scope: Time windows, selected fields, mean and median, complex phase tracking, real delays, flags, uncertainties, in-place updates and rate-aware fringe solutions. paired.result: 28 paired case groups and four downstream applications passed.
